title: 2006 Raytheon ATFLIR patent and Gimbal rotation

tellings.quote: So and also this was uh a patent from I believe 2006.

plain: Mick West, a skeptic who analyzes UFO videos, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a patent he believes is from 2006, filed by the defense company Raytheon for ATFLIR, a targeting camera pod carried on Navy fighter jets. He connects it to 'Gimbal', a Navy video in which an unidentified object seems to rotate, arguing the patent helps explain that rotation as something the camera itself does rather than the object.
